sentences.en: Linen thread is durable and has a beautiful silver color.
sentences.zh: 亚麻线耐用且有一种美丽的银色。

sentences.en: The heavy oak tables were covered with snow-white linen.
sentences.zh: 那些沉重的橡木桌子铺着雪白色的亚麻布。

sentences.en: She made a satin skirt and a linen blouse.
sentences.zh: 她做了一条缎面裙子和一件亚麻衬衫。

senses.zh: 亚麻布，亚麻织品；床单，桌布等亚麻制品

mnemonic: 联想记忆：line（绳）+n→亚麻编的绳→亚麻织品
